supersedable_only_by: A newly sealed artifact with a distinct SHA256 and a fresh independent PASS bound to that exact SHA256.
findings: sealed tar was stale relative to reviewed source
bootstrap rollback could falsely report success under Bash conditional errexit semantics
required review manifests and procedures were outside the sealed tar
production migration used anonymous Docker runners that could survive client timeout
durable production migration interruption recovery was absent
production DATABASE_URL was not bound to the inspected database user and name
a stale backup could be reused across attempts
outbox catalog validation did not prove the complete exact schema
release activation interruption recovery was incomplete
activation postcheck did not pin command, user, workdir and entrypoint
audit serialization allowed concurrent service-restart mutations
